blocks.html: Notes
While inside Erebus your time and movement speed will be limited.
blocks.text: While inside Erebus your time and movement speed will be limited.

blocks.html: You must obtain 100% Erebus Rift Attunement by mining shadow animica rocks and capturing regular and skittish motes of shadow anima. There are 25 of these objects to find.
blocks.text: You must obtain 100% Erebus Rift Attunement by mining shadow animica rocks and capturing regular and skittish motes of shadow anima. There are 25 of these objects to find.

blocks.html: Obtaining 100% attunement takes multiple trips into Erebus.
blocks.text: Obtaining 100% attunement takes multiple trips into Erebus.

blocks.html: You can initially explore Erebus for 1 minute before you are pulled out of the area.
blocks.text: You can initially explore Erebus for 1 minute before you are pulled out of the area.

blocks.html: When you are pulled out of the area you will keep the level of Erebus Rift Attunement and any item that you gained, but some aspects of the environment reset to their initial state.
blocks.text: When you are pulled out of the area you will keep the level of Erebus Rift Attunement and any item that you gained, but some aspects of the environment reset to their initial state.

substeps.html: At 20% attunement your movement speed is increased slightly.

substeps.html: At 40% attunement you can stay in Erebus for an additional 15 seconds at a time (a minute and 15 seconds without the handicap).
